verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents creating GPU machines from the console, REST API, or CLI, with a choice of machine type, template and region. Its "ML in a Box" template comes with CUDA and ML frameworks preinstalled, and you get SSH root access, so you can start running code right away. A community user also confirms renting hourly GPU VMs on demand. However, high-end GPUs such as the H100 need approval first, and one hands-on user calls getting SSH access "an uphill battle", which softens the "within minutes" claim. Missing for 10: independent evidence of time-to-running-code (the only figure is the vendor's "signup to training in seconds" claim), immediate access to high-end GPUs without approval, and a published OpenAPI spec for the API.
